in_sanskrit.name: उत्पल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Utpal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'utpala', which means 'lotus'. In Hinduism, the lotus flower is considered a symbol of purity, creation, and enlightenment.

in_hindi.name: उत्पल
in_hindi.long_meaning: उत्पल नाम हिंदू भाषायिक स्वरूप से 'उत्पल' (utpala) है जो 'लोतुस' (lotaS) का अर्थ है। हिंदूधर्म में लोतुस फूल पुरुषकारिक रूप के साथ शुधि, सृष्टि और तत्वज्ञान के सymbol है।

in_tamil.name: உத்பல
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Utpal in Tamil is derived from the words 'utpalaM' and 'maram', which mean 'lotus' and 'platform' respectively. Together, these words mean 'lotus platform', symbolizing the divine lotus seat of Lord Vishnu.

in_telugu.name: ఊట్పల
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Utpal in Telugu is derived from the words 'utpalaMu' and 'chauderdhAnamu', which mean 'lotus' and 'mountain' respectively. Together, these words mean 'lotus on the mountain', symbolizing the divine lotus seat of Lord Vishnu.

in_marathi.name: Utpal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Utpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Utpala’, meaning ‘golden flower’. This name symbolizes the beauty and strength of nature, and is often given to a child born during the spring season.
